history: The drink that carried Jägermeister from German digestif to nightclub staple through the 1990s and 2000s.
whyItWorks: The energy drink’s sugar and acid flatten the amaro’s bitterness; the carbonation carries it down fast.
steps: Pour the energy drink into a pint glass, about half full.
Fill a shot glass with chilled Jägermeister.
Drop the shot glass into the pint and drink immediately, before it foams over.
techniqueNotes: Both components must be cold or it foams badly.
Drop it, do not pour it — the point is the mix happening in the glass.
name: Jägerbomb
description: A shot of Jägermeister dropped into half a glass of energy drink.
